content.rendered:
? (He shot back 3)
?
2 days ago , we saw how brother *Nehemiah “shot” back at his antagonists in;*
✔Nehemiah 2:20a MSG
I shot back, “The God-of-Heaven will make sure we succeed…✔
?
Yesterday, we also saw how David shot back at Goliath
?
*Today* , we shall be looking at another man who ” *shot* ” back when he & his people were entrapped

?His name was Moses.

Exo. 14v12 KJV
And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
?
Moses’ task was clearly spelt out to him…” *bring my people out of Egypt that they may serve Me upon this mountain “*

His mission was clearcut, but what remained “vague” was the entire process A-Z.
?
At a time, he was stuck between Pharaoh’s army and the Red Sea. Truly, there was no visible way out…Many even geared at him & threatened to stone him…this wasn’t a good time for him.. he must have felt lonely… As it were, he was between “the devil & the deep blue sea”

?The combination of a dead end situation and certain death from Pharaoh’s army wasn’t a palatable situation at all.

*The situation was speaking loudly to Moses.*

Sometimes, we get ” *trapped* ” even in the will of God.?

We wonder if this was God’s idea of being funny because, to you, things really ain’t funny.

You look everywhere, only to see numerous dead ends.??‍♂

What we really don’t see or feel at such times is God’s presence.
?
Isaiah 43:2 MSG
When you’re in over your head, I’ll be there with you. When you’re in rough waters, you will not go down. *When you’re between a rock and a hard place, it won’t be a dead end*

To God, when He sends you on a mission, there are no dead ends even if it does look that way.
?
The situation spoke to Moses, but Moses shot back immediately ignoring the rants of even his people.

?He shot back with a great move of faith and the rest they say is history.
?
Your situation may not be as dramatic as Moses’, but, whenever you are in what seem like in-between a rock and a hard place, know that it is not a dead end ( *Isaiah 43v2)*

?You shoot back by taking action.
?Take action by speaking the Word
?Take action with a move of faith.
?Take action with prayer & fasting.

*Don’t just stand there and sulk while you watch your life and all your labour going down south.*

Everything is provoked by a move.

*Today, dare to speak, dare to move, dare to praise, dare to worship.*

There is a way out of that mess and you will see it today and give a victory dance afterwards in Jesus name??????????????????????
